rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a person who is competent at many different things.

example.english: They can play the piano, paint, and cook—they’re truly versatile.
example.traditional: 佢識彈琴、畫畫，仲識整嘢食，真係多才多藝。
example.jyutping: keoi5 sik1 taan4 kam4 waa2 waa2 zung6 sik1 zing2 je5 sik6 zan1 hai6 do1 coi4 do1 ngai6

rows.note: Use this for an object, product, or tool that can be used for many different purposes.

example.english: This versatile rice cooker can cook rice and make soup.
example.traditional: 呢個多用途電飯煲又可以煮飯，又可以煲湯。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 do1 jung6 tou4 din6 faan6 bou1 jau6 ho2 ji5 zyu2 faan6 jau6 ho2 ji5 bou1 tong1

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is on something being changeable or not fixed, rather than useful in many ways.

example.english: This singer is versatile, with a gentle style one moment and a fierce one the next.
example.traditional: 呢個歌手嘅風格好多變，一時溫柔，一時又好剛烈。
example.jyutping: nei1 go3 go1 sau2 ge3 fung1 gaak3 hou2 do1 bin3 jat1 si4 wan1 jau4 jat1 si4 jau6 hou2 gong1 lit6
